newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways June same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways June same-store sales down.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said same-store sales for the five weeks ended July 5 were down 5.5 percent.
The building materials retailer said total sales for the period were down seven percent to $266.3 million from $286.5 million in the year-ago period.
For the year to date, Payless Cashways' same store sales fell 3.2 percent from a year ago. Total sales were off 5.4 percent from the comparable period last year to $1.42 billion.
The company operates 194 building materials stores in 22 states.
